title: Independent audit of manual Solana Helius CA-first entrypoint
objective: Independently audit the bounded manual Solana Helius CA-first entrypoint. Verify that it only returns the declared first-look fields, uses no provider except the approved Helius boundary, fails closed without a runtime credential or on unavailable data, and does not reach AnalysisService, persistence, queues, caches, automation, address-library, or deep-analysis paths.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Helius or any other provider, and do not require or inspect a runtime credential.
Do not change implementation, tests, runtime configuration, scheduler, database, cache, queue, chain activation, or automation behavior.
Do not print, store, commit, or record credentials, bearer values, raw provider payloads, or credential-bearing URLs.
